source.author: verg
source.text: Hospitio prohibemur harenae; bella cient, primaque vetant consistere terra.
source.text_original: Hospitio prohibemur harenae; / bella cient, primaque vetant consistere terra.
source.text_english: We are barred from the shore by our host; they stir up war, and they forbid us first to set foot on land.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text_english: we are barred from lodging at the arena.
